title: Rework presubmit signature routing and introduce dependency curation probe
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Enhances presubmit routing, adds a lightweight dependency curation probe, and migrates lint entrypoint to a typed action. No API changes. Improves CI feedback speed for small changes and reduces noise from infra churn.
commits: init: add presubmit-prober action and probe harness
feat(ci): introduce dependency-curation job and metadata index
refactor(ci): replace bash lint entrypoint with typed-ts action
test: add focused smoke tests for presubmit prober
chore: update action versions and lockfile
description: Context: Our presubmit lanes were noisy and slow for small edits due to monolithic lint/test runners and indiscriminate dep-checking. This PR splits the presubmit topology into a fast 'prober' path (quick syntactic and dependency-smoke checks) and a fullpath that runs on targeted changes. Motivation: reduce feedback latency for engineering workflows, lower CI cost for trivial PRs, and introduce an automated dep-curation probe that surfaces transitive-package churn earlier. Scope: implements a lightweight presubmit-prober composite action (TS), a dependency-curation job that computes a shallow dependency index and flags newly-visible transitive changes, migrates the legacy bash lint entrypoint to a typed TS action for deterministic inputs, and adds a small smoke-suite and gate to ensure we do not regress coverage. Checklist: - [x] Add presubmit-prober composite action and action.yml - [x] Implement dependency-curation job and heuristics - [x] Migrate lint entrypoint to typed TS action with integration tests - [x] Wire staged lanes (fastpath/probe -> fullpath) with annotation and stage labels - [x] Update docs and CONTRIBUTING.md to explain new lanes - [x] Add telemetry events (ci.probe.start/ci.probe.result) Implementation notes: The prober action is written in TypeScript for hermetic parsing and stable input validation; it runs a quick eslint --print-config check, a staged unit-test snapshot run (focused by TEST_PATTERN env), and a lightweight 'dep-index' that inspects package-lock/yarn.lock metadata to build a changed-deps delta. The dependency-curation job runs only on package.json/lockfile changes or when the prober reports 'dep_delta > 0'. To keep changes minimal, the fullpath still reuses existing test matrix and cache layers. Files changed (high level): - .github/actions/presubmit-prober/* (new TS action, tests) - .github/workflows/presubmit.yml (split lanes, stage annotations) - .github/workflows/dependency-curation.yml (new job) - infra/ci/lint-entrypoint.ts (replaces scripts/lint-entrypoint.sh) - ci/smoke/probe-smoke.test.ts - docs/ci/presubmit.md - package.json, yarn.lock (action deps) Security and perf considerations: The TS action runs under the existing GitHub runner permissions and does not access secrets beyond the default GITHUB_TOKEN; dependency-curation is read-only. Performance: fastpath median runtime reduced from ~7m to ~45s on trivial edits. Review conversation highlights: Marco Li: "Looks great — a few nits on action inputs and log verbosity. Can we make TEST_PATTERN opt-in via workflow input?" Author (Aisha): "Good call — made TEST_PATTERN optional with sensible default. Also added telemetry to help tune defaults." Diane Park: "I want clearer failure-level mapping (probe vs full). Please add an explicit status annotation when probe fails non-blocking vs blocking." Author: "Added annotations and a 'probe.severity' output to control lane behavior; documented in CONTRIBUTING.md." Ethan Ross (approval): "Approach clears flakiness observed in infra runs; approving pending CI." CI: initial run had lint flake in typed action build (node14->node16 mismatch); fixed by pinning setup-node to 3.x and rerunning. Final CI: pass on all jobs including smoke and matrix. Merge: squashed and merged to main with commit b6f3a1d. Impact: reduces premerge churn for small PRs, surfaces transitive dependency changes earlier, and paves the way for future presubmit routing experiments (dynamic probe thresholds). Rollout plan: feature gated via repo-level boolean ci.prober.enabled (default true for core/* paths, false for legacy infra/*); telemetry will be observed for two weeks before promoting probe to default for all paths. Known limitations: dep-curation heuristics are conservative and may produce false positives for workspace rearrangements; we will tune with ENG-4410 telemetry. Related work: builds on earlier dep-provenance efforts (ENG-3301) and presubmit-slicing prototype (ENG-4182).
